source.author: k0morebi
source.text:
Been playing with meshcore for 4 weeks. Underwhelming would be a polite way to describe my experience. I'm in a suburban area and my house is at center of 2 (now 3) repeaters all less than 500m away. I have yet to receive a single reply on any test messages into the very busy public or local channels. I can't even message between my handheld node and some at my house when walking around the neighborhood. But I'll receive garbage "hello from city {x}" messages in public from nodes that are hundreds of km away (some a bit over 800 km). Smoke signals would be more reliable and less lossy.

I plan to stop wasting money on lora stuff. Will use for long range home automation on the property only.
